phrases.zh: 在我看来；依我看来；据我看来
syn: as far as I am concerned
phrases.ex: In my opinion, lifelong learning is essential in a rapidly changing world.

phrases.p: as far as I am concerned

adv.t: As far as I am concerned, ...

phrases.ex: As far as I am concerned, reading broadens our horizons.
From my perspective, the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks.
Personally speaking, I prefer studying in a quiet library.

syn: there is a widespread belief that
phrases.ex: It is widely believed that education can change one's fate.
There is no doubt that technology has transformed our lives.
I am convinced that persistence is the key to success.
It goes without saying that health matters more than wealth.
In my view, universities should encourage independent thinking.
To my mind, the advantages of online learning are obvious.

syn: I am of the opinion that

adv.t: I am of the opinion that ...

phrases.ex: I hold the view that everyone should have access to education.
It is universally acknowledged that practice makes perfect.

phrases.zh: 随着……的发展；随着…的发展
phrases.ex: With the development of the Internet, online shopping has become part of daily life.
In contemporary society, people are under increasing pressure.
In recent years, artificial intelligence has developed rapidly.
Nowadays, more and more students choose to study abroad.
When it comes to choosing a career, personal interest matters.
As for the environment, everyone can make a difference.

phrases.zh: 在……方面；用...的话；根据；按照；在...方面
phrases.ex: In terms of efficiency, high-speed rail is hard to beat.

phrases.zh: 连同；随着；与…一道；与…一起；连同…
phrases.ex: Along with economic growth, environmental problems have emerged.
Great progress has been made in the field of medicine.
Against the backdrop of globalization, cultural exchange is increasingly important.
Due to the heavy rain, the match was postponed.

adv.t: Owing to the lack of funds, ...

phrases.ex: Owing to his hard work, he passed the exam with ease.
Many health problems result from an unhealthy lifestyle.
His success can be attributed to years of hard work.
The new policy may give rise to a series of changes.
Regular exercise contributes to both physical and mental health.

phrases.zh: 源于；起源于；出自；出身于…
phrases.ex: Their disagreement stems from a lack of communication.

phrases.zh: 解释；占……比例；对…负有责任；对…做出解释；说明……的原因；导致；（比例）占
phrases.ex: Several factors account for the popularity of short videos.
As a result, the company's profits increased by 20 percent.
He ignored the warning; consequently, he made the same mistake.
The evidence is insufficient; therefore, we need more research.
We should save energy, thus reducing carbon emissions.
Careless driving can result in serious accidents.
The Internet has brought about profound changes in communication.
The policy was poorly designed; in consequence, it failed.
Early education has a profound impact on a child's development.
The plan sounds attractive; however, it may be too costly.
The task is difficult; nevertheless, we must complete it.
He is not lazy; on the contrary, he works very hard.

phrases.zh: 相比之下；对比起来；与之相比；相反地
phrases.ex: By contrast, rural areas have a slower pace of life.
In comparison with printed books, e-books are more portable.
Some students prefer group work, whereas others prefer independent study.
Despite the difficulties, she never gave up.
In spite of his age, he remains energetic.

adv.t: On the one hand, ...; on the other hand, ...

phrases.ex: On the one hand, technology saves time; on the other hand, it may isolate us.
On the other hand, online learning requires strong self-discipline.
Moreover, regular exercise improves sleep quality.
Furthermore, the new system is easier to operate.
In addition, volunteers can gain valuable experience.
What is more, this approach is environmentally friendly.

adv.t: Not only does ..., but it also ...

phrases.ex: Not only does reading broaden our horizons, but it also improves our writing.
The course develops speaking as well as writing skills.
Apart from its cost, the plan has another disadvantage.

phrases.zh: 最重要的是；尤其是；首先
phrases.ex: Above all, we should learn to think independently.
For instance, many young people now learn through short videos.
For example, online courses allow students to study at their own pace.
Languages such as English and Spanish are widely spoken.

phrases.zh: 一个恰当的例子；恰当的例子
phrases.ex: A case in point is the rapid development of mobile payment.
Take the Internet as an example; it has changed the way we learn.
To illustrate, consider the case of a student learning a new language.

adv.t: It is high time that we took action.

phrases.ex: It is high time that we attached greater importance to mental health.
The government should take effective measures to reduce pollution.

adv.t: We should attach greater importance to ...

phrases.ex: Schools should attach importance to students' mental health.

adv.t: More attention should be paid to ...

phrases.ex: We should pay attention to the environmental cost of development.
Both individuals and governments should make efforts to protect the environment.
Campaigns can raise public awareness of food waste.
Parents play a vital role in shaping their children's values.
Reading is beneficial to both language ability and imagination.

phrases.zh: 有助于；对…有帮助；有益于…
phrases.ex: A positive environment is conducive to learning.

phrases.zh: 优先考虑；给…以优先权；优先考虑…
phrases.ex: Policy makers should give priority to public health.
In conclusion, lifelong learning is both necessary and rewarding.
To sum up, the advantages of this policy outweigh its disadvantages.
In summary, technology is a double-edged sword.

phrases.zh: 总的来说；总而言之；合计；头等重要的东西
phrases.ex: All in all, the trip was a valuable experience.
On the whole, students benefit from part-time jobs.
In a word, education is an investment in the future.
Taking all factors into consideration, I believe the plan is feasible.
As has been mentioned above, both sides have valid points.
To a great extent, our habits determine our health.

phrases.zh: 在一定程度上；在某种程度上
phrases.ex: To some extent, money can bring happiness.
Online education is increasingly popular among adults.
The new policy has significantly reduced air pollution.
The number of online shoppers has risen dramatically.
Working conditions have improved considerably in recent years.
The company's revenue grew substantially last year.
She has made remarkably rapid progress in English.

syn: I am writing in order to
I am writing with regard to

adv.t: I am writing to apply for ...

phrases.ex: I am writing to apply for the position advertised on your website.

adv.t: I would like to express my sincere gratitude.
adv.zh: 我想表达我诚挚的感谢。

phrases.ex: I would like to invite you to our English speech contest.

syn: I hope to hear from you soon

adv.t: I am looking forward to your early reply.

phrases.ex: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

adv.t: Thank you for your time and consideration.

phrases.ex: Thank you for your help during my stay in London.

adv.t: I would appreciate it if you could ...
adv.zh: 如果您能……，我将不胜感激。

phrases.ex: I would appreciate it if you could reply at your earliest convenience.

adv.t: Please feel free to contact me.

phrases.ex: Please feel free to contact me if you need further information.

phrases.zh: 此致敬礼；诚挚的问候；最好的祝福；致敬
phrases.ex: Best regards, Li Hua
Yours sincerely, Li Hua

adv.t: ... is an integral part of traditional Chinese culture.
adv.zh: ……是中国传统文化不可或缺的一部分。

phrases.ex: Traditional Chinese culture has a long and rich history.

adv.t: ... has been listed as intangible cultural heritage.

phrases.ex: Paper cutting is a form of intangible cultural heritage.

phrases.zh: 春节；春节（中国农历正月初一）

adv.t: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
adv.zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。

phrases.ex: The Spring Festival is celebrated with family reunions and fireworks.

adv.t: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion.
adv.zh: 中秋节是家人团聚的时刻。

phrases.ex: People eat mooncakes and admire the moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival.

adv.t: China's high-speed railway network is the largest in the world.
adv.zh: 中国的高铁网络是世界上最大的。

phrases.ex: The high-speed railway has shortened travel time between cities.

adv.t: Mobile payment has become part of everyday life.
adv.zh: 移动支付已成为日常生活的一部分。

phrases.ex: Mobile payment makes shopping more convenient.

adv.t: The shared economy has created new forms of employment.
adv.zh: 共享经济创造了新的就业形式。

phrases.ex: Bike-sharing is a typical example of the shared economy.

adv.t: Artificial intelligence is reshaping many industries.
adv.zh: 人工智能正在重塑许多行业。

phrases.ex: Artificial intelligence has been applied in education and healthcare.

adv.zh: 环境保护需要共同努力。

phrases.ex: Environmental protection is essential for sustainable development.

adv.t: Sustainable development balances economic growth and environmental protection.
adv.zh: 可持续发展平衡经济增长与环境保护。

phrases.ex: The concept of sustainable development has gained global recognition.

adv.t: Cultural confidence is the foundation of national development.
adv.zh: 文化自信是国家发展的基础。

phrases.ex: Cultural confidence enables a nation to embrace the world.

adv.t: Social harmony depends on mutual respect.
adv.zh: 社会和谐取决于相互尊重。

phrases.ex: Education contributes to social harmony and progress.

整理；解决；挑选出；弄清楚
把事情处理好；理清问题
